description: Perfume and fragrance gift ideas from who the gift is for: recipient (him, her or anyone), relationship, age range, perfumes or notes they already love, style, occasion and how adventurous to be. Each pick comes with the reason it suits them. Use for 'gift for a woman who loves Delina', 'something safe for my dad' or 'a bold present for a friend'. Not for personal taste recommendations (use recommend_perfumes) and not for classics lists (use search_perfumes with iconic true).

boldness.description: safe: crowd-pleasing classics; adventurous: distinctive niche picks

locale.description: Language of the 10ml.com links and labels.

loves.description: Perfumes they already wear or love, e.g. ["Delina"]

occasion.description: When they would wear it most, e.g. "office"

recipient.description: Who the gift is for: him (men and unisex), her (women and unisex) or anyone (unisex-friendly)

response_format.description: concise (default) or detailed (adds pyramid, seasons, occasions, longevity).

style.description: Up to 3 style words for the scent they like, e.g. ["fresh", "woody"].

items.description: A style word the scent should have.

name: find_gift
title: Find a perfume gift
